changelog:
Version 0.2.3 of 8004-mcp

- Added detailed onboarding instructions, including first-time setup, wallet encryption, and funding guidance.
- Expanded documentation for all core read and write operations, with example code for each.
- Clarified error cases and troubleshooting steps for common issues (e.g., locked store, insufficient funds).
- Documented global agent ID formats across supported chains (Solana, Ethereum, Base).
- Updated cost estimates for on-chain operations on Solana and EVM networks.
summary: Register and manage agent identity, reputation, and feedback on Solana and EVM chains using the multi-chain ERC-8004 Agent Registry protocol.
